items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names reveal intent (ensureHeader, writeChunk, readNextChunk, validateEnabledConfig), exported items have doc comments, constants are named (nonceSize, sentinelSize, hmacSize), and formatting matches the repo. Short receivers like ew/dr are normal Go style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: LoadKey repeats the same base64-decode and length-check block for env, file and literal. A dead `func (job Job) validate() error { return job.Validate() }` wrapper is left behind. UnmarshalYAML adds unrequested snake/kebab key handling. save() validates, then LoadKey validates again.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped with %w (ErrInvalidKey) and the key is copied. Nonces come from crypto/rand, and Close is idempotent while keeping the stored error. Truncated streams map to ErrUnexpectedEOF. The env var is checked with LookupEnv plus an empty check. The closer order (gzip → enc → pipe) is correct.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: The required changes are done and unencrypted output is unchanged. PathGenerator keeps its signature by passing a hardcoded false. Extras: UnmarshalYAML accepts additional YAML keys (key_source, key-env-var, …), extra exported constants (KeySource*, KeySize, MaxChunkSize), and a new Encryptor.DecryptReader method.
